items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Zero-Day RCE (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations and has been actively exploited in the wild. Adobe released an emergency hotfix to address this zero-day flaw.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including two high-severity stored cross-site scripting issues that do not require authentication and could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Critical Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (Unauthenticated Privilege Escalation)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. Indications suggest active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability (Unrestricted File Upload)
items.summary: A critical remote code execution vulnerability in Adobe Commerce caused by unrestricted file upload with dangerous types. Attackers can execute arbitrary code by uploading malicious files.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.
